ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Southern South America changed by −1.14 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −1.59 to −0.70), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is a decrease of about 2.82 kg/m².
